versions.changelog:
- Initial release of frontend-slides: create standalone, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files.
- Zero dependencies—produces a single HTML file with inline CSS/JS; no npm or build tools required.
- Strict viewport-fitting: every slide fills exactly 100vh with no scrolling; enforces content density limits and automatic overflow splitting.
- Visual, aesthetics-driven design process; avoids generic look-and-feel through distinctive typographic, color, and animation choices.
- Supports three modes: new presentation creation, PPT(X) conversion, and enhancement of existing HTML slides.
- Editing: option for in-browser text editing with local storage and export.
